certifications.name:
CCNP Service Provider
Cisco Certified Network Professional (Service Provider Core + Advanced Routing); full CCNP SP certification.
CCNA
Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA); foundation in networking, routing, switching, and troubleshooting.
DevNet Associate
Cisco Certified DevNet Associate; knowledge of network automation, APIs, Python, and programmability.
Cisco AI Practitioner
Cisco Certified AI Technical Practitioner; applied AI/ML concepts for enterprise and SP network operations.
RHCSA (RH199)
Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA); expertise in Linux administration, scripting, and automation.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
Cisco Ideathon/Hackathon
Selected among the Top 10 teams on a global level; ideated, designed, and presented DeFix, an automated defect- identification and bug analysis tool for service software, successfully deployed and operational across Cisco teams.
Cisco Excellence Award
Recognised for outstanding performance in escalation management and customer delivery, accelerating resolution of 10+ high-severity incidents and reducing customer downtime by 40% year-on-year across SP environments.
CSAT Commendation Letters
Received formal appreciation from 4 Tier-1 SP operators (NBN, RJIL, Rakuten, NEC Australia), acknowledging consistently superior technical support quality and strict SLA adherence across 60+ critical cases per month.
CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS
NMS & Network Mgmt.
EPNM • Crosswork Network Controller (CNC) • Cisco Prime Network Registrar (CPNR) • NMS • NSO
Protocols & Architecture
BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VLAN, DTP/VTP, STP, RIP, EIGRP, HSRP, ACL, NTP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QOS
Cisco Platforms
IOS-XR • IOS-XE • NCS Series • Optical Devices • Routers & Switches •CML Labs •Cisco Packet Tracer
Automation & DevOps
Python • Ansible • Jenkins • Docker • Linux • Git •Postman •Docker
Programming
Python • C++ • Java • .NET • SQL
Ticketing & CRM
CSone (Salesforce-based) — case management, SLA tracking, escalation documentation
LEADERSHIP, MENTORING & VOLUNTEERING
Mentoring & KT Sessions
Designed and delivered 10+ Knowledge Transfer sessions on CCNA/CCNP certification prep to 25+ engineers (freshers and experienced), improving team certification pass rates and fostering a knowledge-sharing culture.
CSR Core Committee
Active core committee member across 6 initiatives (Asha Tails, Teach for India, Banashree Foundation, Gift Abled, Tamahar, and Jagruthi Trust), co-organising 10+ events spanning education, inclusion, and animal welfare.
Sports & Team Events
Represented teams in 5 inter-office sports (Box Cricket, Throwball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess); planned and executed 10+ workplace and community events, demonstrating stakeholder coordination and leadership.
Cisco Campus Ambassador
Supported Cisco hiring initiatives, fresher onboarding, and team mapping activities; facilitated orientation sessions and engagement programs, impacting 300+ students and improving recruitment coordination and awareness.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Consulting Engineer Cisco Systems Jan 2022 – Present Bangalore, India
Optical Hardware Engineering (Mar 2026 – Present)
NMS Product Engineering (Jan 2022 – Mar 2026)
Transitioned to Cisco's hardware division, conducting fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis on Cisco optical transport systems, reducing outage resolution time by 30% through systematic validation frameworks faster. • Collaborated with hardware engineering and product teams to document 20+ failure modes and escalate the firmware defects, contributing to 3 major product quality improvements deployed across global SP networks.
Served as POC for 4 global SP accounts (NBN, RJIL, Rakuten, NEC Australia), resolving 60+ cases/month across complex multi-vendor production, carrier-grade, high-availability, and critical network environments.
Achieved 98%+ SLA compliance and earned CSAT commendations from Tier-1 SPs for critical support. • Built SME expertise across Cisco EPNM, CNC, and CPNR; improved overall first-call resolution by >25%. • Reduced customer-reported downtime by 40% via proactive RCA and permanent fix implementation across BGP, OSPF, and MPLS on large-scale SP production, multi-vendor, critical carrier backbone networks. • Engineered and validated BGP, OSPF, and MPLS configurations on IOS-XR and NCS Series platforms for large-scale SP environments serving 10M+ subscribers, ensuring consistent 99.9% network service uptime. • Developed Python and Ansible scripts eliminating 8+ hrs/week of manual tasks per engineer, cutting time- to-resolution for 5 recurring network issue categories by 50% across large-scale SP operations environments.
